resumeText:
Neha Joshi | Bengaluru | neha.joshi@example.com

SUMMARY
Product leader with 13 years in fintech and SaaS products.

EXPERIENCE
Group Product Manager, Coral Payments, Bengaluru (2020 - present)
- Own the product roadmap for merchant lending and payouts.
- Run customer discovery with merchants before every major bet.
- Set the north star metric and KPIs for the lending line.
- Wrote the business case for a new working capital product.
- Planned product launches with marketing and sales for three products.
- Line manager for five product managers.
- Use stakeholder communication with engineering, design and risk.
- Led the build vs buy decision for the loan management system.

Product Manager, Pinecrest Software, Pune (2015 - 2020)
- Ran the invoicing product.

Business Analyst, Konkan Infotech, Pune (2013 - 2015)

EDUCATION
MBA, IIM Indore, 2013
BTech, VJTI Mumbai, 2011
